markup: <footer>© 2026 ESnet. All rights reserved. Navigation links, legal text, and supplementary information go here.</footer>
overview: A full-width container anchored to the bottom of a page or layout. Use it to hold closing content such as navigation links, legal text, contact details, or supplementary information.

whenToUse: At the bottom of a page or layout to hold copyright notices, legal text, navigation links, and supplementary information
When content needs to be semantically marked as a footer landmark for assistive technology
do: Include copyright, contact information, and legal links within the footer element
Keep footer content brief and supplementary — it supports the page but should not carry primary actions
dont: Don't place primary calls-to-action or important user-facing content in the footer — users are unlikely to look there first
Don't use multiple footer elements within a single page section; use one per distinct landmark region
